provenance: New cases authored during AI-assisted development, before execution against the app. Not externally reviewed, not independently adjudicated, and not a new held-out benchmark.
policy_scope: Intake search and clarification only; no eligibility or financial action decisions.

cases.customer_statement: The debit was 42 on 15-10-2026. I cannot remember which currency the statement showed.
facts_required: Bank records TX-1003 and TX-1004 dated 2026-10-15 with nominal amount 42
cases.reason: Missing currency does not prevent confirmed nominal-amount lookup; never infer a currency.

cases.customer_statement: The debit was INR 42 on 15-10-2026. I remember which currency the statement showed.
facts_required: Same records as CH-01, both INR
cases.reason: Explicit currency adds an exact filter; supplied INR does not change this fixture's candidate set.

cases.customer_statement: Northstar appears beside a debit of INR 42 dated 15-10-2026.
facts_required: Same owned card and date/amount anchors; merchant names do not filter search
cases.reason: Merchant assertion is context, not a transaction identifier or authorisation fact.

cases.customer_statement: Cedar appears beside a debit of INR 42 dated 15-10-2026.
facts_required: Same facts as CH-03; only reported merchant changes
cases.reason: An irrelevant merchant edit must leave search candidates unchanged.

cases.customer_statement: I paid INR 42, maybe on 15-10-2026. I need to check the date before you search.
facts_required: No verified transaction selected; date is explicitly uncertain
cases.reason: A possible date cannot be silently accepted as an exact search date.
cases.acceptable_alternative: Ask the customer to confirm an explicit date range; do not search first.

cases.customer_statement: I paid INR 42 on 15-10-2026. I checked the date before asking you to search.
facts_required: Same nominal payment details as CH-05; date is now explicitly stated
cases.reason: Explicit date enables confirmation, not automatic search or transaction selection.
